name: Flight Minutes
summary: Learns how long your flight paths take and shows a countdown to the landing from the second flight on.
logoPrompt: A round brass pocket stopwatch with a plain dial without numerals and one glowing hand, with a pair of small feathered wings spread from its sides, tilted slightly

cover.tagline: Know when you land, on every flight path.
bullets: No setup, no data to download

description: **Flight Minutes times every flight path you take and, from your second trip on a route, counts down the minutes and seconds until you land.**
## Features
- Learns each route while you fly. It ships without any data: every time is measured on your own flights.
- On a known route a small frame shows your destination and a countdown such as "Landing in 2:41".
- On a new route it shows the time flown so far and prints the measured time in chat after landing.
- Keeps an average of your last five flights per route.
## How to use
Just fly. Drag the small frame to move it, the position is saved. `/fm` (or `/flightminutes`) tells you how many routes are known.
## In detail
### Learning a route

When you pick a destination on the flight map, Flight Minutes notes where you start and where you go. The timer starts at take-off and stops when you land. A route and its way back count as two routes, because they often take a different flight time. A short loading screen on the way does not end the timing. Flights under 5 seconds or over an hour are not stored. After the first flight on a route, a chat line tells you how long it took.
### The countdown

On a known route the frame shows the destination and counts down in minutes and seconds. When the time is up it says "Landing any moment ...". On a new route it says "Learning this route" with the time flown so far. The frame only appears while you fly, near the top of the screen until you drag it somewhere else.
### Average flight time
Every route keeps your last five measured times, and the countdown uses their average, so small differences between flights even out.
### Commands
- `/fm` – shows how many routes your faction knows.
- `/fm list` – lists every route with its flight time in chat, sorted A to Z, up to 40 lines.
- `/fm forget` – clears all learned routes of both factions.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail. No combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons, and nothing to set up.
- The addon is in English.
- Times are shared by all characters of one faction on your account. Alliance and Horde routes are kept apart and saved until you use `/fm forget`.
- A flight you end early with the stop button is not counted, and the frame says so.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
